title: Saniasu
description: A modpack specifically for the Saniasu Client
body:
### Saniasu?
The world might be different, but it’s sure to be exciting. Who would have thought this modpack could completely transform your gameplay? This modpack features performance improvements and a fantasy world.

### Features
- World Generator - A fantasy world with landscapes reminiscent of fictional worlds
- Biomes - Featuring over 35 biomes and explore them all
- Mobs - There are mammals and monsters you haven't encountered yet
- Boss - Warriors are always eager for battle, but the boss is very hard to defeat
- Tools - Some useful tools for building and survival
- Decorations - Many decorations resemble the real world

### FAQ
> **Can I play multiplayer?**
> 
> **Yes**, You can play with your friends, but you and the other players must all be using the same version of this modpack
> 
> **Does this modpack run smoothly in terms of FPS??**
> 
> **It depends on your device**, Some devices may experience smooth FPS, while others may experience a drop in FPS due to incompatibility
> 
> **Where can I ask for help/report a bug?**
> 
> You can visit us on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/9wPEkqAC3n) for more detailed information
